config_management.title: Configuration Management
config_management.info1: Full configuration update may regenerate credentials; use 4 / 7 / 8 / 9 for a single field
config_management.info3: Includes Nginx update, domain change, web config
config_management.info4: Change the actual listen port and preserve other fields; SNI external ports are not supported here
config_management.info7: Change only the main managed VLESS account; preserve other users and the separate Fallback UUID
config_management.info8: Rotate only the managed REALITY inbound key pair; every client of that inbound must update its public key
config_management.info9: Change only the managed REALITY inbound ShortId; affected clients must synchronize; backup, validation and confirmation required

config_edit.warning: This changes only the selected setting. Affected clients must synchronize. REALITY keys, ShortId and port are inbound-level settings and affect every client using that inbound. Confirm you can update those clients; firewalls and cloud security groups are not modified automatically.

config_edit.test_failed: The candidate Xray configuration failed validation; the original configuration was not replaced. Credential-bearing diagnostics are not echoed.
config_edit.write_failed: Configuration write failed; attempting to restore the previous configuration.
config_edit.restart_failed: Xray restart or state verification failed; attempting to restore the previous configuration and service state.
config_edit.rollback_failed: Recovery did not fully succeed. Inspect the configuration and service using the reported backup location before retrying any changes.
config_edit.success: The selected setting was updated; synchronize affected clients now.
config_edit.share_hint: For standard generated configurations, use main menu 7 for current share information. Synchronize custom multi-user accounts manually; the share menu may not represent a non-first account.
config_edit.unsupported_mode: The current profile does not support this independent edit.
config_edit.state_mismatch: The runtime Xray configuration disagrees with script state. Refusing to overwrite existing settings.
config_edit.duplicate_uuid: The new UUID conflicts with an existing account; choose another UUID.
config_edit.port_conflict: The new port conflicts with an existing listener; choose another port.
config_edit.key_failed: The REALITY key pair could not be generated or validated; configuration was not changed.
config_edit.unchanged: The new value matches the existing setting; no configuration write or service restart was needed.
config_edit.busy: Another configuration edit is in progress. Nothing was changed; try again later.
config_edit.concurrent_change: Another process changed the configuration during this operation. Aborting instead of overwriting its changes.
config_edit.service_state_failed: The Xray service state could not be determined reliably; the change was aborted.
config_edit.backup_root_invalid: The backup directory is unsafe or unavailable. Check its permissions and links before editing.
config_edit.rollback_done: The previous configuration and service state were restored; this change did not take effect.
config_edit.internal_error: The independent edit encountered an internal error. Check the reported recovery status; credentials were not echoed.
config_edit.client_uuid: Client synchronization: set User ID / UUID / id to the new value below:

config_edit.client_reconnect: Save the settings on every affected client, then disconnect, reconnect and test the connection.
